snippet.title: TimeWarp Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for the game TimeWarp.
https://cammydev.neocities.org/projects

The crustiness is very intentional, I wanted to make something in the vein of E3 trailers for 90's shooters, something kinda like the early trailers for Half-Life or Daikatana.
Whether I succeeded at that or not, that's up to you.
